ImageDescription.value:
Anjarle is a village in the Konkan region of Maharashtra, India. The villages in this region depend a lot on fishing and transporting goods. There are some developed fish markets around here, where trade happens during the day.

In the monsoon seasons, fishermen are often not able to to go to the sea. The photograph shows a number of boats parked in a creek near Anjarle village. At the distance one can see the sea and impending rain. The primary objective of this photograph was to capture the rustic feel.
It also attempts to tell a real story.

Note: This photograph uses Adobe RGB color space. It is recommended that the photograph be viewed in a browser/image viewer that supports non-sRGB color space. Safari and Firefox include non-sRGB color space support by default
